messages.error.permission: ⛔ You do not have permission to use this command.
messages.error.unexpected: 💥 ComradBot tripped over a gear. Try again in a moment.
messages.help.title: 🤝 ComradBot command guide
messages.help.description: Use the slash commands below. Discord will show each command's parameters while you type.
messages.help.music.name: 🎵 Music
messages.help.music.value:
`/music play` — search for or play a public URL
`/music pause` · `/music resume` · `/music skip`
`/music stop` · `/music repeat` · `/music disconnect`
`/music queue` · `/music now`
`/music volume` · `/music remove` · `/music clear`
`/music playlist` — persistent server playlists
messages.help.sounds.name: 🔊 Custom sounds
messages.help.sounds.value:
`/sound upload` · `/sound play` · `/sound random`
`/sound list` · `/sound info`
`/sound metadata` · `/sound rename` · `/sound delete`
`/sound audit` — moderator history
`/sound export` · `/sound restore` — moderator backups
messages.help.ai.name: 🤖 AI
messages.help.ai.value:
`/ai ask` · `/ai discover` · `/ai reset` · `/ai summarize` · `/ai transcribe`
`/ai speak` · `/ai status` · `/ai usage`
AI commands require a configured provider; audio features work without one.
messages.help.start.name: Getting started
messages.help.start.value: Join a voice channel before starting music or sounds. Use `/ping` to check whether the bot is responding or `/health` for dependency status.
messages.help.settings.name: ⚙️ Server settings
messages.help.settings.value:
`/settings show` · `/settings volume` · `/settings ai`
`/settings ai-memory` · `/settings ai-budget` · `/settings sounds`
Changing settings requires Manage Server permission.
messages.help.footer: ComradBot — organized audio for the collective.
